name: @shelamkoff/mentionjs
description: Lightweight @-mention autocomplete for textarea and contenteditable. No dependencies.

scripts.build: terser mention.js --compress --mangle --comments false --output dist/mention.min.js && lightningcss --minify mention.css -o dist/mention.min.css && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('mention.d.ts','dist/mention.d.ts')"

author: shelamkoff
